Principles #

The same seven lines open the README, which is the first thing an AI assistant reads.

  • Name the role, not the page.Tokens and components describe the job they do, so a recipe app, a docs site and this portfolio can share them.
  • Colour and type carry meaning.Hue marks a link, a status or focus. Ornaments are decoration, always hidden from assistive tech.
  • Measure it, don't eyeball it.Reading text meets 7:1, controls and focus meet 3:1, and every pair is checked in both themes on every build.
  • HTML first, script second.Content, navigation and code work without JavaScript. Scripts add the theme toggle, copy buttons and TOC tracking.
  • Square, hairline, labelled.Structure is drawn with 1px rules, square corners and mono labels, like a field ledger. Buttons, nav items and icon-only controls are the one exception: they are pills, so anything you can press is recognisable at a glance.
  • Motion confirms a change.Only state changes animate, plus the pausable drift of the contour survey behind the page; text never moves, and reduced motion means none.
  • One accent, one ornament.Sap green marks action. Yarndings and the contour survey (the backdrop, or the specimen plate) are the only decoration, once per view.

Tokens

Foundations #

Five dye-plant hues, three typefaces and a 4px grid. Primitives hold raw values; everything you build with is a semantic token that points at them, and dark mode re-points the same names.

Semantic roles color.*

Each role names its light and dark primitive. The page switches with light-dark(), following your system unless you pick a theme.

TokenLightDarkUsage rule
color.surface.baseash.50ash.900Page background and the default canvas behind all content. Use once per page, on body.
color.surface.raisedash.0ash.850Framed objects that sit on the page: cards, accession labels, the sticky header, table bodies. Never as page background.
color.surface.sunkenash.100ash.950Recessed areas that hold machine text: code blocks, inline code, table header rows, keyboard keys.
color.surface.hoverash.100ash.800Background of an interactive row or card while hovered. Only as a hover state; never at rest.
color.surface.inverseash.900ash.100Background of tooltips and other small transient labels that must stand out from every surface. Never for panels or cards.
color.surface.highlightsap.100sap.800Text selection, <mark>, and the current item in site navigation. Never for large areas or decoration.
color.text.primaryash.950ash.100Body copy, headings and any text a reader must read. Default text colour.
color.text.secondaryash.800ash.300Supporting reading text: ledes, summaries, captions, blockquotes. Still AAA, so it can carry full sentences.
color.text.mutedash.700ash.400Metadata only: dates, reading time, counts, label keys. Never for sentences or body copy (AA, not AAA).
color.text.accentsap.700sap.300Short accent text: accession numbers, eyebrow labels, the current nav item. Never for paragraphs; use color.link.* for links.
color.text.inverseash.50ash.900Text on color.surface.inverse (tooltips). Only there.
color.text.on-accentash.0ash.1000Text and icons placed on color.accent.fill.*, such as primary button labels. Only on accent fills.
color.link.restsap.800sap.300Inline links in running text. Always underlined so colour is not the only cue.
color.link.hoversap.900sap.200Inline link while hovered or focused. Pair with a thicker underline, not colour alone.
color.border.subtleash.200ash.800Decorative dividers inside a component: table row rules, list separators. Never the only boundary of a control.
color.border.defaultash.300ash.700Outlines of non-interactive framed objects: cards, labels, code blocks, figures.
color.border.strongash.500ash.500Boundaries of interactive controls (secondary buttons, inputs, toggles) and hovered card outlines. Meets 3:1 non-text contrast.
color.accent.fill.restsap.700sap.300Fill of the one primary action in a view. One per view; never for large panels.
color.accent.fill.hoversap.800sap.200Fill of a primary action while hovered or pressed.
color.accent.bordersap.600sap.400Accent rules that mark the active item: current nav underline, active TOC entry, hovered tag. Not for static decoration.
color.focus.ringwoad.700woad.300Keyboard focus outline on every focusable element. Always drawn with border.focus.offset so it sits on the surface, not the control.
color.ornament.restsap.600sap.400Yarndings ornaments and the specimen plate's contour lines. Decorative only: always aria-hidden, never carries meaning.
color.ornament.strongsap.800sap.200Emphasised stitches that trace structure inside an ornament, and the plate's index contours (every fifth line). Decorative only; never for text.
color.ornament.mutedash.400ash.700Registration ticks on framed objects and the plate's survey grid. Decorative only; no contrast requirement.
color.status.success.textsap.700sap.300Short labels and titles that signal a completed or passing state. Always paired with a text label, never colour alone.
color.status.success.surfacesap.50sap.950Background of a callout or banner that signals a completed or passing state. Body text on it uses color.text.primary.
color.status.success.bordersap.600sap.400Emphasis rule on a component that signals a completed or passing state, e.g. a callout's leading edge.
color.status.warning.textweld.700weld.300Short labels and titles that signal a caution the reader should act on. Always paired with a text label, never colour alone.
color.status.warning.surfaceweld.50weld.950Background of a callout or banner that signals a caution the reader should act on. Body text on it uses color.text.primary.
color.status.warning.borderweld.600weld.400Emphasis rule on a component that signals a caution the reader should act on, e.g. a callout's leading edge.
color.status.danger.textmadder.700madder.300Short labels and titles that signal an error, a destructive action or a breaking change. Always paired with a text label, never colour alone.
color.status.danger.surfacemadder.50madder.950Background of a callout or banner that signals an error, a destructive action or a breaking change. Body text on it uses color.text.primary.
color.status.danger.bordermadder.600madder.400Emphasis rule on a component that signals an error, a destructive action or a breaking change, e.g. a callout's leading edge.
color.status.info.textwoad.700woad.300Short labels and titles that signal neutral supplementary information. Always paired with a text label, never colour alone.
color.status.info.surfacewoad.50woad.950Background of a callout or banner that signals neutral supplementary information. Body text on it uses color.text.primary.
color.status.info.borderwoad.600woad.400Emphasis rule on a component that signals neutral supplementary information, e.g. a callout's leading edge.

Typefaces font.family.*

Three OFL families, 88.0 KB in total as Latin-subset WOFF2. National Park comes from US national-park trail signage; it carries display, body and UI. JetBrains Mono carries code and every label.

display | body

National Park

Variable 200–800, 38.1 KB. Tabular figures built in. No italic: emphasis uses weight, and <em> falls back to a synthetic oblique.

mono

JetBrains Mono

Variable 100–800, 39.5 KB. Code, accession numbers, dates, tags and table headers. Ligatures off in code.

ornament

kWfgc·AW

Yarndings 12, 10.5 KB. Knitting-chart dingbats on a 12px stitch grid. Decoration only, always aria-hidden.

Type scale font.size.*

Fluid between 360px and 1440px: ratio 1.2 on phones, 1.25 on desktop. The two smallest steps stay fixed so labels never shrink below 12px.

Measure and leading size.measure.prose

Running text stops at 66 characters with 1.6 line height. Headings use 1.25, display lines 1.1 with tight tracking, and mono labels are tracked out by 0.08em.

Analytics infrastructure is mostly plumbing: an event schema agreed before the first dashboard, a pipeline that rejects malformed payloads loudly, and a warehouse that can answer the question someone will ask in six months. This paragraph is set at the prose measure so you can see where lines break.

Size size.*

size.container.page

69rem (1104px) page width with a 16–40px gutter. Never full-bleed text.

size.container.breakout

60rem for wide figures, tables and code inside articles.

size.measure.prose

66ch running text; captions 52ch; code fits 80ch.

size.target.*

24px minimum for inline controls, 40px buttons, 44px nav links.

size.column.*

15rem side column (TOC); 20rem minimum card and plate.

size.breakpoint.*

48rem and 64rem for SCSS media queries. CSS layouts here are intrinsic instead.

Radius and border radius.* | border.*

radius.none

Cards, labels, tags, tables, code: everything structural.

radius.pill

Buttons and icon-only controls: cx-button, copy, the theme toggle, heading anchors.

radius.control

Square. Text inputs, selects and keyboard keys.

radius.round

Status dots only.

border.width.hairline

1px. Every rule and outline.

border.width.emphasis

2px. Active states and callout edges.

Focusedborder.focus.*

2px woad ring, 2px off the element.

Motion motion.*

Hover or focus a track to run it. With reduced motion turned on in your system, every duration below becomes 0ms.

duration.fast | easing.standard

120ms. Hover colour, borders, the button arrow.

duration.base | easing.standard

200ms. Disclosures and the TOC marker.

duration.slow | easing.enter

320ms. Rare one-off confirmations.

duration.plate | easing.enter

1600ms. Each contour's draw-in, once, on load.

duration.drift | linear

60000ms for the contour terrain to drift one noise unit, behind the frost or on the plate. The only loop; always pausable, and still under reduced motion.

Never moves: text, headings, layout, page transitions, scroll-triggered reveals. Theme changes and focus rings are instant. The contour drift is the one loop: it has a pause control and stops under reduced motion.

A token without a rule is a colour with a name. An assistant can't tell color.accent on a button from color.accent on a full-page background, so the description becomes the contract.

Why tokens need rules #

Every semantic token carries a usage rule in its $description. The MCP server returns it with the value, and the assistant follows it like a lint message.

  • Name the role, never the page.
  • State when not to use it, not only when to.
  • Keep it to one or two sentences.

The pairs contract #

Text tokens list the surfaces they may sit on. Press Ctrl + K in the dashboard to search pairs, or query the server directly.

Things that are easy to build are also reliable.

Jensen Huang | Jensen Huang gets mobbed by engineers in Taiwan, Lex Fridman

Failure modes

  1. A pair is declared but one theme fails: CI blocks the release.
  2. A component uses a primitive directly: the validator flags it.

What comes next #

Version the rules like code. Renaming a semantic token is a major release.g

Heading anchor heading-anchor.md

A "#" after every section heading that has an id, so any section can be linked to. It sits in a 44px round target like the theme toggle, appears on hover or focus, and stays visible on touch screens. The section headings on this page use it.

Hugo's Chroma output with a header bar for the language and file. Line 6 is highlighted with hl_lines. The copy button appears only when JavaScript runs.

Figure and caption figure.md

Diagrams and screenshots are numbered as plates. Captions sit under the frame at the caption measure; the breakout variant widens to 60rem.

Four kinds, each named in its title so colour is never the only signal.

Checks #

Results from the build that generated this page.

  • Pass

    Contrast. 95 of 95 declared pairs meet their target in both light and dark. Lowest reading-text ratio: 7.20:1.

  • Pass

    Naming. 299 tokens (153 semantic): kebab-case or integer segments, four segments at most, every semantic token described and pointing at a primitive.

  • Pass

    No raw values. Outside the generated :root block, every colour, size and duration in this page's CSS, inline styles and script is a --cx-* variable.

  • Pass

    Fonts. 88.0 KB across three OFL families, against a 200 KB budget.
